articles.summary: Product Eazipay vs SeamlessHR: Which Payroll Solution Is Right for Your Business in Nigeria? Oluwakemi Adesina November 8, 2026 Choosing the right payroll software can feel like navigating traffic in Lagos during rush hour, there are too many options, everyone is honking for your attention, and you just want to get to your destination without breaking down. If you are trying to decide between Eazipay and SeamlessHR, you are likely looking for a tool that takes the stress out of paying salaries, calculating PAYE, and handling statutory deductions. But which one actually fits your team? Honestly, it depends on what your business needs right now. If your main goal is to run payroll in minutes, automate your tax and pension filings without stress, and keep your HR operations lean and straightforward, Eazipay is built right for you. On the other hand, if you are running a large enterprise that needs deep HR modules like applicant tracking systems (ATS), shift rostering, and continuous performance appraisal tools, SeamlessHR is worth evaluating. Evaluating payroll solutions for your business? Book a Demo with Eazipay today to see how automated payroll and statutory compliance can transform your operations. What Are Eazipay and SeamlessHR? Before checking feature details, let us look at what each platform was designed to do for Nigerian businesses. Eazipay is a dedicated payroll and HR solution built specifically to solve the payment and compliance bottlenecks Nigerian companies face every month. Instead of forcing you through weeks of setup, Eazipay focuses on doing the heavy lifting where it matters most: calculating net pay accurately, executing direct bulk salary transfers to any Nigerian bank, and automatically filing PAYE taxes, Pension, NHF, NSITF, and ITF. It is fast, intuitive, and designed to let founders and HR teams handle payroll without needing a finance degree. SeamlessHR is an enterprise HR management platform built to handle complex workforce structures across Africa. It offers an all-in-one suite that connects payroll processing directly to broader enterprise HR functions. That means if your organization needs to manage recruitment pipelines, conduct 360-degree performance reviews, track shift rosters, and integrate with enterprise ERP systems like SAP or Oracle, SeamlessHR provides those extensive modules. Eazipay vs SeamlessHR: Feature-by-Feature Comparison Here is how both platforms compare across key business capabilities: Feature / Capability Eazipay SeamlessHR Core Payroll Processing Automated gross-to-net calculations, multi-tier approvals, bulk runs) Configurable pay structures, multi-cycle payroll runs) PAYE & Statutory Workflows Direct filing and remittance for PAYE, Pension, NHF, NSITF, ITF Automated calculations, tax reports, and remittance workflows Bulk Salary Payments Instant single-click disbursements across all Nigerian banks Direct bank disbursements and recurring payment tracking Employee Self-Service (ESS) Web & mobile access for payslips, tax receipts, and leave requests Web portal, mobile app, and WhatsApp self-service HR & Employee Management Employee records, leave tracking, onboarding, document management Full HR suite: ATS, performance appraisal, leave, time tracking Payroll Reports & Audit Trails Automated cycle reports, complete audit logs, exportable tax receipts Custom reporting options and historical audit trails Integrations Bank payment gateways, accounting software, HR data tools) ERP connectors for Microsoft, Sage, SAP, Oracle) Implementation Setup Rapid setup; self-onboarding or guided setup within hours) Custom enterprise onboarding and team training) Pricing Model Custom enterprise quote based on selected modules Custom enterprise quote based on selected modules Payroll Processing and Automation When it is 5:00 PM on payday, no HR manager wants to be stuck fixing formula errors on a massive spreadsheet. You want a system that processes payments cleanly and accurately. Day-to-Day Payroll Execution With Eazipay: The process is straightforward. You log in, update any variable allowances or one-off deductions for the month, preview the automatically computed gross-to-net figures, hit approve, and disburse salaries in a few clicks. It is designed to remove friction, saving you hours every pay period. With SeamlessHR: The engine is built for multi-entity structures. If you have hundreds of staff spread across different legal entities, departments, and pay grades, SeamlessHR lets you set up multi-tiered approval chains to ensure every level of management signs off before funds move. Handling Exceptions Before choosing any tool, think about how often your business handles “payroll surprises” like mid-month hires needing prorated pay, sudden bonus payouts, or staff exiting mid-cycle. Eazipay lets you make instant adjustments directly from your dashboard, while SeamlessHR handles these adjustments through structured approval workflows. PAYE Calculations and Filing Eazipay handles statutory obligations end-to-end. It calculates your PAYE deductions; it actually files and remits payments directly to the respective State Internal Revenue Services. You get official government receipts right on your dashboard, keeping you fully audit-ready without visiting a tax office. SeamlessHR calculates PAYE accurately according to Nigerian tax laws and generates clean schedules. Your finance team can then use these exportable reports to process filings through government portals. Pension and Multi-Agency Obligations Missing remittance deadlines leads to heavy fines. Eazipay routes pension contributions straight to your employees’ respective Pension Fund Administrators (PFAs) alongside your main salary run. SeamlessHR provides centralized compliance tracking to help enterprise finance leads monitor these obligations across large teams. Bulk Salary Payments and Operations Disbursing salaries across dozens of microfinance and commercial banks in Nigeria requires reliable payment channels. Bulk Payment Workflows: Both platforms allow you to pay your entire staff directly from the system without exporting CSV files to upload on corporate banking sites. Handling Failed Transfers: If an account number is wrong or a receiving bank network is down, Eazipay flags the specific failure immediately on your dashboard with clear diagnostic details, so you can retry that single transfer without delaying the rest of the company. SeamlessHR maintains enterprise-grade logs linked to system accounting modules to help finance teams reconcile bank statements. HR Features and Business Requirements Payroll is a huge piece of the puzzle, but what about the rest of your HR operations? Employee Self-Service Eazipay gives your employees a modern, self-service web and mobile portal. Staff can log in anytime to download their monthly payslips, view historical tax receipts, request leave, or update personal information saving
